dimensions.evidence: Claims and provenance remain strong, but different viewpoints weaken the user-facing before/after comparison.
News, Reading Trail and More are empty; a genuinely old-to-current comparison is missing; round selection requires new work.
The 2009/2017 main pair is not visually comparable enough, and Objects versus Structures is an artificial split in the current Torggata surface.
CI, runtime, no-WebGL routing and the four-plus-Badge layout remain technically verified.
People holdbacks, source boundaries and asset controls remain valid; no new safety issue was identified.
Traceability is strong, but the previous quality gate failed to catch visible editorial weakness and has now been tightened.
